issues.problem: The plugin-delivered path is no longer side-effect free: roots now calls stable_install_path(raw_install_path), which creates or re-points <...>/silver-bullet/current inside Claude Code's own plugin cache and shutil.rmtree()s a real current/ directory. At ae12e03 delivered mode touched nothing; the doc (scaffold-steps.md 3.7.5) and commit d618105 present it as a no-op apart from settings removals. The alias is only needed as a string for ownership matching.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H2b-probe/mh: registry lists silver-bullet@alo-labs with installPath .../plugins/cache/alo-labs/silver-bullet/0.53.0; merge-hooks.py -> 'removed 0 duplicate settings entries', settings.json untouched, but .../silver-bullet/current -> 0.53.0 symlink created; with current/ a real dir holding keep.txt it is deleted and replaced by the symlink. Same input with ae12e03's merge-hooks.py: no current/ created.
issues.suggested_fix: Compute the alias path without touching the file system (re.match(r'^(.*?/silver-bullet)/\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') -> group(1)+'/current') for roots, and call stable_install_path only in the manual-install branch; add a test that delivered mode leaves the plugin cache directory listing unchanged.

issues.problem: codex_marketplace_root now needs tomllib/tomli/pip's vendored tomli. sb_host_config is designed to work without a parser (check_toml is a no-op then), but here toml_parser() returns None, loads(None) raises TypeError, the broad except swallows it and the installer silently uses ~/.codex/.tmp/marketplaces/alo-labs-codex although a local marketplace is registered (Python <= 3.10 without tomli or pip, e.g. a minimal Ubuntu 22.04). The same silent fallback hides an invalid config.toml.
issues.evidence: PYTHONPATH=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H2b-probe/noparser (tomllib, tomli and pip shadowed to raise ImportError): toml_parser() -> None; [marketplaces.alo-labs-codex] source_type=local source='<dir>/plain dir' -> codex_marketplace_root prints .../.codex/.tmp/marketplaces/alo-labs-codex; ae12e03's line reader under the same PYTHONPATH prints '<dir>/plain dir'.
issues.suggested_fix: When toml_parser() is None, read the table with TomlDocument (keyval statements for ('marketplaces','alo-labs-codex','source'|'source_type'), decoding the value with the lexer's string readers); print a warning to stderr when the config cannot be read instead of falling back silently.

issues.problem: The repair only removes silver-bullet@ trust tables, but the pre-fix Kay-mode seeder (02eff38 hooks.sh) wrote trust for every hook in ~/.codex/hooks.json under the user prefixes (<home>/.codex/hooks.json:<event>:<g>:<h>) with the same duplicate-table bug. Such a config is not repaired, and the full install aborts at remove_marketplace_if_present with an error that names a silver-bullet@ key and gives no way forward.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H2b-probe/rep2: config with [hooks.state."<home>/.codex/hooks.json:pre_tool_use:0:0"] and [hooks.state."silver-bullet@alo-labs-codex:...:0:0"] each declared twice (second copy after a bare [hooks.state]); repair_silver_bullet_duplicate_trust_tables; remove_marketplace_if_present silver-bullet-local -> 'ERROR: ...config.toml: not valid TOML (Cannot declare (... 'silver-bullet@alo-labs-codex:hooks/hooks.json:pre_tool_use:0:0') twice ...); left unchanged', rc=1.
issues.suggested_fix: Treat duplicated [hooks.state."<user hooks.json prefix>:..."] tables as repairable too (or collapse byte-identical duplicate trust tables keeping the first), and extend the error with how to proceed (remove the duplicated [hooks.state."..."] tables).

issues.problem: The purge writes ~/.codex/hooks.json before the config.toml edit is built and validated, and rename_tables only handles [table] headers: a stale trust written as a dotted key at a re-key target ([hooks.state] "<key>:0:1".trusted_hash = ...) is not removed, the rename then declares that table twice, write_toml refuses, the purge exits 1 (install aborts under set -e) after hooks.json was already rewritten, and the user's trust stays keyed to the old positions. Dotted-form sources are never re-keyed.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H2b-probe/kay2: hooks.json [Bash:[SB completion-audit], Edit:[/usr/bin/u1,/usr/bin/u2]]; config: [hooks.state] "<hj>:pre_tool_use:0:1".trusted_hash = "sha256:stale-dotted", tables for :1:0 and :1:1; purge_legacy_silver_bullet_hooks_from_user_config -> 'ERROR: ... Cannot declare (...pre_tool_use:0:1) twice', rc=1, hooks.json WAS rewritten to [[u1,u2]].
issues.suggested_fix: Build and validate the new config document first, then write hooks.json, then config.toml; make rename_tables' stale-target removal drop any statement whose path starts with a target path (dotted keys included), and rename dotted-key sources too.

issues.problem: Stale SB Cursor agents are now kept for good. The namespace rule requires a currently shipped bundle, so legacy SB names are only reported: subagent-sb:init (the stale SB agent this test used as its fixture until 7ac8b95 swapped it for the shipped sb:add) stays in the picker, and the former SB bundle names silver:* (26 in host-bundles/cursor history, e.g. silver:plan, silver:review) do not match SB_NAMESPACE, so they stay without even a note. Run from an installed cache without host-bundles, nothing in the namespace is ever cleaned.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H2b-probe/r711: ~/.cursor/agents/{subagent-sb:init,silver:plan,sb:add,silver-surfer}/SKILL.md + silver-lining.md; cleanup_cursor_custom_agents -> only sb:add quarantined; Notes for silver-lining.md, silver-surfer, subagent-sb:init; silver:plan left with no output. `git log --diff-filter=D -- host-bundles/cursor` lists silver:agent-claude ... silver:verify (26 names) no longer shipped.
issues.suggested_fix: Quarantine names SB is known to have shipped: the current bundle list plus a fixed legacy list (the silver:* and subagent-sb:* names from history); add 'silver:' to the reporting regex; keep the user-safety test and restore a test with a legacy SB fixture.
